waive.health: /health (src/health.ts) reports provenance, schema, FTS, bindings and backup freshness, and the deploy's live gate reads it; healthResponse's ping-and-backup shape would drop what the gate checks
waive.explorer:cspReport: the explorer is an assets-only Worker with no code; its CSP reports to Capsid's own /csp-report, which uses receiveCspReport

copies.src/github/client.ts: readKey here names a KV cache key for a GitHub read, not a frontmatter field
copies.test/portal-actions.test.ts: its GitHub fake answers GET /pulls/41 (the head sha approve_pr pins), a route devkit's stubGitHub does not have
copies.test/repo-tools.test.ts: manage_pr's cases need the pull request routes (GET and PATCH /pulls/5, PUT /pulls/5/merge, POST /pulls, DELETE of a ref), which devkit's stubGitHub does not have
copies.test-integration/gate-policy-resume.test: its GitHub fake answers GET /pulls/40 for the job's head sha, a route devkit's stubGitHub does not have
copies.test-integration/portal-actions.test.ts: its GitHub fake answers GET and PATCH /pulls/41, GET /repos/:repo and a branch DELETE, routes devkit's stubGitHub does not have
copies.test-integration/shadow-routes.test.ts: the key pair and key set stand in for GitHub Actions' OIDC issuer (src/shadow.ts verifies shadow-test.yml's token), not Access: devkit's stubAccess signs Access's token and claims

libraries.jose: search-console.ts signs the Google service account's JWT and shadow.ts verifies GitHub Actions OIDC tokens; site-runtime's ./access and ./access-login verify only Cloudflare Access tokens
